name: Discord Messenger & Controller
description: Autonomously send messages, DMs, announcements, or notifications to Discord channels and users using Webhooks, Bot API, or by launching Discord deep links.

tools.name: discord_send_message
tools.description: Send a message or notification to a Discord channel or user via Webhook or Bot Token.

recipient.description: Target recipient name, channel name, or user ID

channel_id.description: Optional Discord channel ID when using bot token

tools.name: discord_send_dm
tools.description: Send a direct message (DM) to a specific Discord user using Discord Bot API or opening the DM in Discord.

tools.name: discord_open_chat
tools.description: Launch Discord or navigate directly to a specific user DM or server channel using deep link.

target.description: User ID, Channel ID, or empty to just launch Discord
